summary.scope: Coverage under fixed budgets; timeouts/errors are reported, not silently treated as exhaustive rule searches. No ULTRA inference or test metrics.

settings.evaluation: retrieval coverage only; no model scores
settings.mask: All 3616 validation/test pairs; all direct predicates and both directions before traversal
settings.edge_count: Unique directed subject-predicate-object triples; duplicate evidence records retain native sampling weight

context_verification.method: Independent raw CSR record scan, all held-out pair mask, sorted unique triples compared elementwise with frozen pilot triples.npy

limitations: ARAGORN templates executed by Gandalf lookup; not live ARAGORN/Retriever backend parity.
Upper edge cap is shared; realized sizes and search budgets are unequal.
Coverage is endpoint presence, not ranking quality or clinical efficacy.
CPU RSS contains shared pages; parent and child peaks are not additive.
driver_elapsed_seconds and load_mask_seconds refer to the final resumed invocation; retrieval totals include all diseases.
